Ahora que viene en camino, esperamos que todo salga bien y se lo encomendamos a Dios, que creo que es lo más importante, para que nazca sano y fuerte. Dani Turcios ha hablado de ti y ha expresado su respeto por estos dos jugadores, destacando lo profesionales que son. ¿Qué opinión te merece que alguien como Dani, que fue seleccionado nacional, piense que eres uno de los jugadores más importantes de este país? Al profe Dani le tengo un cariño enorme. Fue mi entrenador en reservas durante mucho tiempo. Cuando él fue el primer entrenador de la reserva, empecé a jugar como titular. Le tengo un cariño enorme y una gran admiración por lo que fue como jugador y por los consejos que nos daba cuando nos entrenaba. Vi la entrevista completa y comparto muchas cosas de las que dijo. Le mando un saludo y un abrazo. Edwin, has regresado en este buen momento. ¿Todavía te ilusiona salir al extranjero? Bueno, creo que los 27 años son una edad perfecta para salir, ya un poco más maduro de lo que habría sido a los 22. Ahora nada más me concentro en lo que estoy viviendo: voy a ser papá, estoy jugando bien y me siento bien. En el futuro veremos qué pasa. Es complejo regresar de la Selección. Allí se te vio a buen nivel, pero no tuviste tantos minutos después de haberte recuperado de una lesión. Hay otros futbolistas que tampoco sumaron minutos, como David Ruiz y Jorge. Me imagino que todos querían jugar y tener participación. ¿Cómo viviste esa situación? Sí, creo que todos queremos sumar minutos. A veces no se puede porque hay casi cinco jugadores convocados por posición, pero vi muy buenas actitudes de muchos compañeros que no jugaron demasiado. En el caso de Jorge, lo menciono porque compartía con él en la mesa y pude ver que tenía una actitud muy positiva. Hablando de eso, me imagino que has estado pendiente de las redes sociales. Se habla mucho del entorno de la Selección y quisiera preguntarte, para que puedas aclararlo, sobre los comentarios de que hay jugadores que no se hablan entre sí. Tú que estuviste ahí, ¿puedes explicar qué sucede? En lo personal, te hablo de mí: comparto con todos, obviamente con unos más que con otros. Pero no sé, no miro mucho esas cosas. A veces hay asuntos íntimos que se hablan entre las personas que los entrenadores decidieron tomar como líderes del grupo. Ellos conversan y en ocasiones, comparten esas cosas con el grupo, pero otras veces no. Lo que sí puedo decir es que, como selección, todos debemos asumir esas responsabilidades y empezar a ejercer ese liderazgo que hace falta para poder sacar el barco a flote. Creo que eso nos ha costado últimamente, pero intentaremos conseguirlo. Cuando escuchas a Dani Turcios decir que la Selección fue lo más lindo que vivió como futbolista, te lo pregunto a ti, que vienes de las categorías menores y ya eres un jugador experimentado: ¿qué significa la Selección para Edwin Rodríguez? ¿Qué piensas cuando escuchas esas palabras? Para mí, representar al país es lo mejor. Creo que así como les hemos dado alegrías a las personas, también hemos tenido momentos difíciles. Hemos disputado partidos importantes desde las categorías sub-20 y sub-23 hasta la selección mayor. También nos hemos quedado un poco cortos en algunas ocasiones, pero son cosas que se hablan y que ya están en el pasado. Ahora nos toca a nosotros asumir esa responsabilidad y dar un paso al frente. A mi criterio, la Selección es lo mejor, y quien venga a representar al país tiene que entregarse al máximo para rendir. Cuando se dice, por ejemplo, que uno de los futbolistas expresó que estaba harto y que no entendía al técnico, José Francisco Molina, ¿cómo lo manejas tú? ¿Entiendes bien lo que te pide el entrenador? Bueno, la verdad es que entiendo lo que él quiere y lo que me pide. Si me pide que juegue a la par del contención, lo hago y punto. Al final, te puede gustar o no, pero si te pone de lateral, tienes que cumplir como lateral. Entonces, no entiendo si se habló de eso o qué fue lo que se dijo. No sé en qué se basaron ni de quién estaban hablando. Pero, si a mí me ponen de portero, te lo digo: en la Selección voy a dar lo mejor de mí para que no me metan goles. Clinton fue el mejor ejemplo (le tocó jugar de latera). Bueno, quizá lo hizo bien, pero no es algo por lo que se caracterice Clinton. Claro que, si te toca, tienes que cumplir y ya. Hay que dar el máximo. Creo que Clinton lo hizo y como te digo, si a mí me toca jugar de delantero, voy a intentar darlo todo, primero para ganarme la oportunidad de jugar y también para darle alegrías a la gente.

data.title: Tesla presenta un carro capaz de volar y acelerar de 0 a 100 kilómetros en menos de un segundo
data.description: Washington, Estados Unidos.- Tesla presentó este jueves 15 de octubre la nueva generación de su deportivo eléctrico Roadster , un vehículo equipado con propulsores desarrollados con tecnología de SpaceX que le permiten elevarse del suelo y realizar maniobras aéreas, además de acelerar de 0 a cerca de 100 kilómetros por hora en menos de un segundo. La presentación se realizó en las instalaciones de pruebas de cohetes de SpaceX en McGregor (Texas), donde el fabricante estadounidense efectuó varias demostraciones de las capacidades del automóvil, cuyo desarrollo acumula casi nueve años de retrasos. En una de las pruebas, el Roadster ascendió por una rampa curva hasta quedar invertido, salió impulsado al aire, realizó una voltereta y aterrizó de forma controlada gracias a sus propulsores. "Bueno, ha funcionado" , declaró el consejero delegado de Tesla, Elon Musk , tras la maniobra. El sistema, desarrollado en colaboración entre ingenieros de Tesla y SpaceX, utiliza aire comprimido almacenado a muy alta presión en lugar de combustible convencional para cohetes. Tesla anunció tres versiones del Roadster: Performance , Thrust y Rocket . La primera, con dos plazas, podrá acelerar de 0 a casi 100 kilómetros por hora en menos de 1,6 segundos y utilizará un sistema de succión bajo la carrocería para aumentar la adherencia al asfalto. La versión Thrust incorporará propulsores traseros que reducirán la aceleración a menos de 0,9 segundos, mientras que la Rocket, de una sola plaza, podrá despegar y maniobrar en el aire, además de alcanzar casi 100 kilómetros por hora en menos de 0,59 segundos, según las especificaciones anunciadas por Tesla. La compañía también aseguró que el deportivo podrá superar los 370 kilómetros por hora y ofrecer una autonomía superior a 480 kilómetros. Musk afirmó que el Roadster será el único automóvil de Tesla diseñado para la conducción manual a largo plazo, mientras la compañía concentra sus esfuerzos en los vehículos autónomos y la robótica. El empresario reconoció que el deportivo no esta necesariamente "optimizado para la seguridad" , lo que plantea interrogantes sobre su homologación para circular por carreteras públicas. Tesla prevé iniciar la producción en 2028 , aunque todavía no ha anunciado los precios definitivos. La segunda generación del Roadster fue presentada inicialmente en 2017, con la promesa de comercializarse en 2020 por unos 200,000 dólares . Desde entonces, el proyecto ha sufrido sucesivos aplazamientos mientras Tesla priorizaba otros vehículos, como el Model Y y el Cybertruck, y posteriormente sus programas de conducción autónoma y robots humanoides.

data.title: Llega a El Salvador comisión del Congreso para conocer el CECOT y analizar reformas de seguridad
data.description: San Salvador, El Salvador.- Con el propósito de replicar nuevas medidas contra las estructuras criminales , el presidente del Congreso Nacional, Tomás Zambrano, junto a una comisión de diputados, llegó a El Salvador para conocer su modelo de seguridad y evaluar medidas que puedan aplicarse en Honduras, Construcción de nuevas cárceles, manejo de privados de libertad vinculados con maras y pandillas y endurecimiento de medidas y condenas son algunos de las propuestas a implementar. Tras su llegada, Zambrano explicó que la comisión, integrada por diputados de las comisiones de Seguridad y Defensa, sostuvo una reunión con el presidente de la Asamblea Legislativa salvadoreña, Ernesto Castro, con quien comenzó a desarrollar un convenio de colaboración entre ambos poderes legislativos. Como parte de la agenda, los diputados sostendrán reuniones con sus homólogos salvadoreños y visitarán el Centro de Confinamiento del Terrorismo (CECOT) , actividad que está prevista para después de la 1:00 pm, debido a otros compromisos de la agenda de seguridad. “Vamos a estar viendo cómo se implementa esa seguridad y el manejo de los privados de libertad declarados terroristas que integran estos grupos criminales de maras y pandillas”, manifestó. Señaló que la visita al país salvadoreño servirá como referencia para las reformas penales que el Legislativo hondureño prevé aprobar en los próximos días. Entre las medidas mencionó la ampliación de 24 a 48 horas del plazo entre la detención y el requerimiento fiscal, así como la posibilidad de realizar allanamientos sin orden judicial en los casos contemplados para grupos criminales declarados terroristas. Asimismo, la prohibición de medidas desjudicializadoras, como la libertad condicional, la preliberación y el procedimiento abreviado, además de la incorporación de juicios expeditos para acelerar los procesos penales contra integrantes de estas organizaciones. “Juicios expeditos también que perfectamente se puede designar a los terroristas un proceso rápido para que tengan sentencias condenatorias no en dos años, sino en un promedio de tres a cuatro meses”, afirmó Zambrano al explicar los objetivos de la reforma. Sobre los tatuajes, Zambrabo aclaró que la medida que plantea el Congreso se refiere a los que solo están vinculados con maras y pandillas. “Es importante aclarar hoy, esto no tiene que ver nada con tatuajes alusivos a la familia, alusivos a paisajes, alusivos a la novia, a la esposa, a los hijos, artísticos que no tienen absolutamente nada que ver con esos tatuajes. Son tatuajes alusivos a maras y pandillas”, expresó. Otro de los objetivos de la visita será conocer las condiciones para construir nuevos módulos y centros penitenciarios en el país. Zambrano afirmó que el decreto mediante el cual se declaró terroristas a determinados grupos criminales autoriza la construcción de nuevas cárceles. El Congreso convocó a sesiones para el lunes y espera recibir la opinión jurídica de la Sala Penal de la Corte Suprema de Justicia sobre la reforma que incluye las modificaciones sobre allanamientos, plazos de detención, tatuajes y procedimientos judiciales expeditos. La delegación hondureña estará acompañada por el director del Instituto Nacional Penitenciario, el general Amador Lacayo, durante la visita al centro salvadoreño.

data.title: Luego de enterrar a su padre, hermanos se atacan a machetazos por una "herencia" en El Paraíso
data.description: El Paraíso, Honduras.- Horas después de enterrar el cuerpo de su padre, un hombre atacó a machetazos a su propio hermano tras tener un conflicto, presuntamente por una herencia , en el municipio de El Paraíso , departamento del mismo nombre. El hecho se registró la tarde de ayer jueves 15 de octubre, cuando familiares llegaron a darle sepultura a don Pedro Merlo, sin imaginarse que momentos después sus hijos estarían involucrados en un violento enfrentamiento. Según las versiones de los hechos, cuando regresaban a su vivienda, los hermanos habrían tenido una discusión, presuntamente por una herencia de su padre, y uno de ellos, identificado como Denis Merlo, enojado, atacó a su hermano con un machete en reiteradas ocasiones. La víctima fue identificada como José Merlo, quien fue trasladado con heridas de gravedad a un centro asistencial de la zona, donde su estado de salud es delicado. Autoridades policiales llegaron hasta el centro asistencial tras conocer el caso de tentativa de homicidio, con el objetivo de asegurar la vida de la víctima. De manera preliminar, se conoce que José Merlo presentaba varias heridas en el rostro. Vecinos del sector manifestaron que la causa habría sido un conflicto por una finca cafetalera, debido a la producción de esa zona, pero esa versión será confirmada por las autoridades. El hecho ocurre días después de otro caso registrado en una comunidad de Muerto Cortés, donde Víctor Antonio Escobar acabó con la vida de su hermano, Mario Roberto Escobar Erazo, de 48 años, con un machete. Víctor se llevó consigo a su hijo, identificado como Salaam Aviezri Escobar Rosales, de 12 años. Según la madre del menor y expareja de Víctor, el conflicto se habría originado por el robo de pertenencias y por problemas recientes que ambos mantenían.

data.title: Oktobarsko ažuriranje Windowsa može firmama prekinuti WiFi i VPN veze: Šta IT služba treba uraditi

data.title: MURTUD VAIKUS ⟩ «Ma peitsin neid pilte aastaid!» Avalikkuse ette jõudnud šokeerivad fotod naise vigastatud näost toovad päevavalgele sünge abieluloo
data.description: Viimastel päevadel on sotsiaalmeedias palju tähelepanu pälvinud šokeerivad fotod raskelt vigastatud näoga naisest. Piltide taga peitub aga lugu abielust mehega, kelle kohta oli juba aastaid varem avalikkuse ette jõudnud tõsiseid süüdistusi. «Need aastad ei olnud ilusad. Viimased poolteist aastat olid väga jubedad,» meenutab naine, kelle sõnul varjutasid kooselu kontrollimine, hirm ja korduv füüsiline vägivald. Nüüd räägib ta Elu24-le, kuidas ilusana alanud armastuslugu muutus õudusunenäoks, mille jäljed saadavad teda siiani. Ka Michael Neumann avab nende abielu tagamaid, kuid tema versioon juhtunust on sootuks teistsugune.

data.title: SUUR LUGU ⟩ SEB Eestis ebaõnnestus rahapesu vastane võitlus
data.description: SEB on jõudnud lõpliku kokkuleppeni New Yorgi osariigi finantsteenuste osakonnaga (DFS). Kokkulepe järgneb asutuse poolt läbi viidud kontrollile, mis käsitles panga varasemaid protseduure ja protsesse seoses kliendi hoolsusmeetmete ning tehingute monitoorimisega panga Balti riikide tegevuses aastatel 2015–2019, teatas reedel börsiteates SEB grupp. Mis täpsemalt juhtus, seda ei kommenteerinud sisuliselt ei pank, rahapesu andmebüroo ega finantsinspektsioon.

data.title: Snowfall hits Romania’s Transfăgărășan, drivers warned of dangerous conditions
data.description: The first heavy snow hit Romania’s famous Transfăgărășan high-altitude road, forcing road workers to intervene with snow-clearing equipment and anti-skid material. The Brașov Regional Directorate of Roads and Bridges (DRDP) announced on Friday, October 16, that a layer of snow has formed on the road, particularly in the highest areas. “Heavy snowfall on DN7C – Transfăgărășan! We are using snow-clearing equipment and anti-skid materials in the alpine area of the Transfăgărășan to clear the significant accumulations of snow from the road,” DRDP said. Authorities advised drivers not to travel on the Transfăgărășan if their vehicles are not prepared for winter conditions. “Weather conditions will remain similar over the next few days, so we ask you not to travel on this section if you are not prepared to drive in winter conditions,” DRDP stated. Salvamont Argeș had previously announced on Thursday evening that it was snowing on the Transfăgărășan, at altitudes of over 1,600 meters, and that reduced visibility required increased caution from drivers and tourists. Mountain rescuers also issued a warning for drivers planning to cross the area, as well as tourists planning hikes at high altitudes. “Do not rely solely on the weather conditions at the time of departure. In the mountains, the weather can change rapidly, and safety must be the priority,” mountain rescuers warned. In emergencies, tourists can call 112 or the National Mountain Rescue Dispatch Center at 0725 826 668. https://www.facebook.com/reel/1620140986823151

data.title: Romania’s center-right parties PNL, USR call for parliamentary committee for administrative-territorial reform
data.description: The National Liberal Party (PNL) and its allies in Save Romania Union (USR) called for the establishment of a parliamentary committee for administrative-territorial reform on Thursday, October 15. The two parties, set to form the opposition in the event of an investiture vote for the Luca Niculescu government , had their request approved by the Joint Standing Bureaus of Parliament. “The request from the PNL and USR parliamentary groups was discussed and approved by the Joint Bureaus, with representatives of the parliamentary groups to submit their proposals so that the draft decision of the Special Committee for administrative-territorial reorganization can be put to a vote,” said Gabriel Andronache, PNL group leader in the Chamber of Deputies, on Facebook. He explained that the deadline was the next meeting of the Standing Bureaus of the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate. “We warn that any postponement or delay of the decision at the next meeting of the Joint Standing Bureaus would constitute a de facto repudiation of the reform initiative we have proposed and will lead us to use the procedural means available to secure the establishment of the Joint Special Committee for the administrative-territorial reorganization of Romania,” the liberal warned. https://www.facebook.com/AndronacheGabriel10/posts/pfbid032cgSDd5Yob1Hsx1jxfXbnkvAdXMZQTYomYAmRpYzCdnDtNmUXNarDG7oriCNb3ECl Earlier, the leaders of the USR and PNL parliamentary groups sent a letter to the Standing Bureaus of the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate requesting the establishment of a committee for administrative-territorial reform. The committee will be tasked with drafting the legislative framework needed for this reform so that it can be implemented starting in 2032. “We expect that the Social Democratic Party (PSD) will support this initiative, given that (party leader) Sorin Grindeanu included administrative-territorial reform among the 10 priorities he asked the government to address just last night. Parliament now has the opportunity to turn political statements into concrete action,” USR said in a press release. USR proposed an administrative-territorial reform of Romania based on financial and demographic data to enable local administrations to provide better public services and manage public funds efficiently. According to the party, implementing such a reform requires thorough legislative preparation, clear rules, and a realistic timetable that gives local authorities the time they need to adapt. A territorial reform has long been promised by Romania’s political leaders, but has always been successfully opposed by the territorial networks of the largest parties, PNL and PSD in particular. The Hungarian minority party UDMR, whose voters are clustered in only a few counties in the center of Romania, has also historically been wary of any such reform.

data.title: Romanian real estate developer One United Properties appoints Cătălin Jalobă as CFO
data.description: Real estate developer One United Properties (BVB: ONE) announced on Friday, October 16, that it has appointed Cătălin Jalobă as Group Chief Financial Officer. He will take office on December 17. In this role, Jalobă will lead the group’s finance function, including financial strategy and planning, accounting and reporting, treasury and financing, cost control, taxation and investor relations. “We are pleased to welcome Cătălin Jalobă to One United Properties. His experience in real estate financing, investment and valuation will strengthen the Group’s financial leadership at an important stage in its development. He brings investment discipline, strong relationships with financial institutions and a clear understanding of the cost of capital,” said Andrei Diaconescu and Victor Căpitanu, Co-CEOs of One United Properties. Jalobă brings more than 20 years of experience in real estate financing, investment, valuation, and development. Since 2017, he has been Head of Real Estate Finance at Banca Comercială Română (BCR), part of Erste Group. He has structured and executed real estate financing transactions exceeding EUR 2.3 billion, coordinated syndicated lending involving European banks, and overseen financing structures, lender relationships, and portfolio Monitoring. From 2014 to 2017, Jalobă was Head of Valuation Advisory and Business Development at JLL, where he oversaw valuation and analysis activities exceeding EUR 4.5 billion annually and advised on institutional real estate portfolios. From 2010 to 2014, he served as General Manager of Price Invest, focusing on valuation, bank advisory, and restructuring. Earlier in his career, he held roles as Expansion Manager at OBI Romania, Country Manager at Arco Capital, and Real Estate Appraiser and Consultant at CBRE. “I’ve sat on every side of the real estate table, and it changed the way I see a project. I see it through the eyes of everyone who believes in it: the families who will live there, the teams who build it, the banks that finance it, and the investors who back it. And I learned one simple truth: capital follows trust, and trust is earned every single day. That’s what drew me to One United Properties,” said Cătălin Jalobă. Jalobă holds an Executive MBA from Maastricht School of Management and has an academic background in law and economics. He is an ANEVAR-qualified valuer and a former board member of RICS Romania. He will succeed Cosmin Samoilă, who is leaving the role to focus on new professional projects.

data.title: Raiffeisen Bank lists new RON 750 mln bond issue on Bucharest Stock Exchange
data.description: One of the largest banks in Romania, Raiffeisen Bank, listed a new corporate bond issue, its tenth overall, worth a total of RON 750 million on the Exchange’s Regulated Market on Friday, October 16. The bank listed 1,250 senior preferred, unsecured corporate bonds with a nominal value of RON 600,000 each and a fixed coupon of 7.538% per annum until 2032, followed by a floating rate calculated as 3-month ROBOR + 0.85% until their maturity on August 13, 2033. The offer was placed via a private placement and subscribed by 12 institutional investors. The funds raised will be used for general corporate funding purposes. The bonds are issued under the Euro Medium Term Note (EMTN) programme, which enables the bank to access international capital markets for financing. The RBRO33 bonds are dual-listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. The Raiffeisen Bank bond issue has been assigned a Baa1 rating by Moody's Ratings. A Baa1 rating places the bonds in the investment grade category, reflecting a stable credit profile for the issuer. “Raiffeisen Bank’s tenth bond issue on the Bucharest Stock Exchange demonstrates that the capital market continues to be an efficient financing channel for banking institutions. We are talking about a pioneer of green bonds in the Romanian banking sector, and the fact that a top-tier financial institution consistently returns to the BVB with bond issuances over the last 13 years proves that the Exchange has become a key platform for major corporate issuances,” stated Remus Vulpescu, CEO of the Bucharest Stock Exchange. Raiffeisen Bank listed its first bond issue on the Bucharest Stock Exchange in 2013. Over these 13 years, the bank has listed 10 bond issues on the BVB, of which four are currently trading: RBRO33 (listed today), RBRO27C, RBRO27B, and RBRO28.

data.title: Bucharest Open Streets draws over 1.5 million visitors in 2026
data.description: More than 1.5 million people participated in the 2026 edition of Open Streets – Bucharest, Urban Promenade , according to municipal cultural center ARCUB. The program ended on October 11 after running for 24 weekends. Organized by the Bucharest City Hall through ARCUB, the project included 226 activities. These comprised more than 100 workshops and interactive experiences, 14 guided tours, and six public debates and thematic meetings. The artistic program featured children’s theater, circus performances, magic shows, street entertainment, concerts, choral performances, and themed parades. Participating institutions included the Ion Creangă Theater, the Țăndărică Animation Theater, and the Comic Opera for Children. Meanwhile, the exhibitions covered historic vehicles, technical heritage, contemporary art, and new media. This year’s edition also introduced public discussions on architecture, urban planning, literature, environmental issues, and sports. The guided tours explored the history and architecture of Calea Victoriei and other parts of Bucharest, while workshops offered painting, kite-making, creative recycling, improvisation, science, and first-aid activities. Fitness, yoga, street workouts, capoeira, and traditional children’s games were also included in the program. Open Streets temporarily restricts vehicle traffic in selected areas to create pedestrian routes and public spaces for cultural and community events. The 2026 edition offered free public access.

data.title: Bucovina named world’s most underrated travel destination for 2027 by Time Out magazine
data.description: Bucovina, a region in northeast Romania, topped Time Out’s newly updated list of the world’s most underrated travel destinations for 2027. Relatively unknown, particularly to foreign travelers, Bucovina was placed first among 41 destinations around the world. The London-based travel recommendations magazine highlighted the region’s painted monasteries and ancient forests to motivate its choice. “What makes Bucovina so special? It’s a deeply traditional region of ancient forests, wildflower meadows and tiny mountain towns, and it’s home to eight UNESCO-listed painted monasteries, churches covered in colourful frescoes of Bible scenes and Romanian folk tales. It’s also where the Via Transilvanica begins, Romania’s 1,400km pilgrimage route that cuts diagonally across the country, passing through around 400 communities and taking roughly two months to walk in full,” according to another Time Out article on the subject . The region was visited by editor Grace Beard, who signalled her enjoyment by ironically asking “Bran Castle, who?” in the ranking. “Bucovina is the heartland for the ancient Romanian art of egg-decorating. You can find hundreds of examples – and buy your own decorated egg – at the National Museum of Painted Eggs in Ciocănești, a town equally worth visiting for its 600 intricately painted wooden houses,” she said in the same list. Second place went to the US’ South Dakota, “which has some equally dramatic national parks without the crowds of Yosemite or Yellowstone.” Third place was won by the Asturian cities in northern Spain, while fourth and fifth place both headed to Latin America, to Osa Peninsula in Costa Rica and San Martín in Peru. The 10 most underrated travel destinations for 2027 are, in order: Bucovina (Romania), South Dakota (US), Asturian cities (Spain), Osa Peninsula (Costa Rica), San Martín (Peru), Zambujeira do Mar (Portugal), Bisbee (US), Shenzhen (China), Carry-le-Rouet (France), and Tioga Pass (US).

data.title: Bucharest launches consultation platform for 2027-2036 cultural strategy
data.description: Bucharest City Hall and municipal cultural center ARCUB have launched an online platform for the development of the capital’s 2027-2036 Cultural Strategy. The website provides access to research documents and allows cultural operators to submit comments and proposals. The strategy is currently in its diagnostic phase, which includes sociological research, specialist reports, and consultations with cultural professionals and local communities. “The new strategy gives us a clear direction for developing culture over the next 10 years, starting from the needs of institutions and audiences,” Bucharest mayor Ciprian Ciucu said. He argued that the capital’s creative industries have significant untapped potential and that the city needs a smaller number of major events with greater regional and international visibility, alongside programs aimed at specific cultural communities. “Our city is not associated with a major cultural event, although we have potential and advantages,” mayor Ciucu said. “The problem is that action has not been clear or coordinated, which is why we have not managed to establish ourselves on the regional or international map.” The research conducted so far has involved more than 500 cultural professionals through interviews, consultations, and focus groups. A quantitative public survey included 800 respondents, while another 80 people participated in 10 focus groups examining cultural consumption. Separate surveys of high school and university students are also underway. Specialists in cultural marketing, heritage, governance, and cultural policy will contribute to the strategy, with international experts expected to join at a later stage. The platform was developed by Insula 42 for ARCUB and implemented by City Hall’s IT department. It will be updated as the strategy progresses and eventually opened for direct participation by Bucharest residents.

data.title: Ipsos survey: Cancer and stress top Romanians’ health concerns
data.description: Cancer is the leading health concern among Romanians, cited by 50% of respondents in an international Ipsos survey. Stress ranked second at 42%, followed by cardiovascular disease at 32%. Meanwhile, obesity was cited by 30% of Romanian respondents and diabetes by 23%. Concern about cancer, cardiovascular disease, obesity, and diabetes was higher in Romania than the average across the 32 countries covered by the study, according to the press release. “Although cancer remains the main source of concern, we see stress approaching it significantly, indicating the growing impact of emotional and lifestyle factors on perceptions of health,” said Irina Nicolaescu, client director at Ipsos Romania. The survey also found that 70% of Romanian respondents considered the country’s healthcare system overstretched, continuing a trend identified in the 2025 edition. “At the same time, the perception of a healthcare system under pressure persists, highlighting the continued need for solutions that improve the patient experience and access to quality medical services,” Nicolaescu also said. Social media has become an important source of information about GLP-1 medications, which are used to treat diabetes and, in some cases, obesity. Among Romanian respondents who had heard of the drugs, 41% said they first learned about them through social media platforms. The Ipsos Health Service Report 2026 surveyed 22,528 adults under the age of 75 in 32 countries between July 13 and August 7. The Romanian sample included 500 online respondents.

data.title: Inside TVCMALL: How a One-Stop Wholesale Platform Works
data.description: Retailers need a reliable supply of products their customers want, but finding the right products isn't always simple. A mobile accessories store, for example, may need phone cases, screen protectors, chargers, and cables for multiple phone models, along with products from other categories. Sourcing from multiple suppliers adds another layer of complexity. Different minimum order quantities, delivery schedules, and ordering processes can make purchasing harder to manage, especially when retailers want to test new products without committing to large quantities. This is where a one-stop wholesale platform can make a difference. By bringing a wide range of products and sourcing services together, it offers retailers a simpler way to manage their purchasing. TVCMALL follows this approach. So how does its one-stop wholesale model work in practice, and what makes it different from traditional wholesale sourcing? What Is TVCMALL? Since 2008, TVCMALL has helped businesses source products for resale. As a one-stop mobile accessories wholesaler , it serves online sellers, marketplace businesses, physical stores, wholesalers, and distributors, offering products across mobile accessories, consumer electronics, and everyday essentials. Its experience in the European market includes partnerships with over 30 leading retailers and annual sales of more than 10 million phone cases. Beyond its product range, buyers can get help with sourcing, discovering new products, and choosing items for their business. Whether you're building an online store or managing a retail business with regular restocking needs, TVCMALL offers a practical place to start. How TVCMALL's One-Stop Wholesale Model Works 1. Source Products Across Categories in One Place Retailers often need more than one type of product to serve their customers. A mobile accessories store, for example, may stock phone cases, screen protectors, and charging accessories for different iPhone and Samsung models, alongside products from other categories. TVCMALL brings together over 1.2 million products from 300+ brands and more than 1,000 verified suppliers. Buyers can explore mobile accessories, consumer electronics, and other product categories in one place, choosing products that fit their customers, budgets, and business needs. Instead of searching across multiple suppliers, retailers can build and expand their product range through a single platform. 2. Order Flexibly to Match Your Business Needs Not every product needs to be ordered in bulk. Retailers may stock up on proven sellers while testing new accessories or styles in smaller quantities. Around 95% of TVCMALL products have no minimum order quantity, allowing buyers to order according to their needs rather than meeting high minimums for every item. This flexibility makes it easier to test new products, respond to customer demand, and manage inventory without overcommitting to unproven stock. 3. Simplify Orders and Shipping Managing purchases from multiple suppliers often means dealing with separate orders, delivery schedules, and shipping arrangements. TVCMALL brings purchasing and order management together on one platform, helping retailers keep track of products across different categories. For buyers sourcing products from multiple channels, TVCMALL also offers warehouse consolidation services. Eligible goods can be brought together at a warehouse and shipped in a consolidated shipment, reducing the need to coordinate multiple deliveries. 4. Customize Products for Your Brand For retailers building their own brand, off-the-shelf products aren't always enough. Adding a logo, creating branded packaging, or developing a custom product can help make their offerings more distinctive. TVCMALL supports logo customization, custom packaging, and OEM/ODM services, depending on the product and project requirements. Whether it's a branded accessory or retail-ready packaging, these services help businesses create products that better reflect their brand and fit their sales channels. Is TVCMALL Reliable? TVCMALL has been operating since 2008 and has built experience serving businesses in the mobile accessories and consumer electronics market. For wholesale buyers evaluating a potential sourcing partner, several factors can help them assess the platform. Industry Experience: Founded in 2008, with over 18 years of industry experience. Customer Reviews: A Trustpilot rating of 4.5 out of 5. Extensive Product Range: Over 1.2 million products and SKUs. Verified Suppliers: Works with more than 1,000 verified suppliers. European Market Experience: Partnerships with over 30 leading European retailers. Conclusion Finding the right wholesale partner involves more than comparing product prices. Retailers also need a practical way to source products, manage orders, and adapt their product range as customer demand changes. TVCMALL brings these needs together in one platform, with a broad product selection, flexible ordering options, order consolidation, and customization services. For businesses looking for a mobile accessories wholesaler that can support different sourcing needs, it offers a convenient option to explore. TVCMALL: Europe's No. 1 One-Stop Mobile Accessories Wholesaler

data.title: Romania wins two bronze medals at European table tennis championships
data.description: Romanian table tennis players Eduard Ionescu and Bernadette Szocs won the bronze medal in the mixed doubles event at the 2026 European Individual Championships in Ljubljana, Slovenia, on Thursday, October 15. The Romanian team lost in the semifinals to the German pair of Benedikt Duda/Nina Mittelham, 3-0 (11-8, 11-4, 14-12). Szocs also won bronze in the women’s doubles event with Elizabeta Samara, securing Romania’s second medal in the event. The road to the podium included three victories against the pairs Dominika Wiltschkova/Ema Labosova (Slovakia), 3-1 (11-4, 11-4, 12-14, 11-7); Lea Rakovac/Hana Arapovic (Croatia), 3-0 (11-9, 11-8, 11-6); and Ying Han/Sabine Winter (Germany), 3-1 (11-9, 12-10, 7-11, 11-4). In the European semifinal, Elizabeta Samara and Bernadette Szocs faced the pair Tatiana Kukulkova (Slovakia)/Natalia Bajor (Poland), the #5 seeds. “The first set was evenly matched and decided by a narrow margin, but their opponents also prevailed in the next two sets, and the Romanian players finished the competition on the third step of the podium, after a 0-3 defeat (11-13, 6-11, 7-11),” said the Romanian Table Tennis Federation on Facebook. https://www.facebook.com/frtmromania/posts/pfbid02nt6uUbgX7p2dd7SkbNG6X9mQ1FRToCQW3wxGmwzDFU6ZSLKnpwMJVC8mC5B2X7Vml?locale=ro_RO In the women's singles event, Romania has three representatives in the round of 16: Bernadette Szocs, Andreea Dragoman, and Elena Zaharia, according to the Romanian Table Tennis Federation's website. In the men's singles event, both remaining Romanian players lost in the round of 32. Eduard Ionescu was defeated by Finland's Benedek Olah 3-4 (8-11, 8-11, 11-5, 8-11, 11-8, 11-9, 6-11), while Iulian Chiriță lost his match against Sweden's Anton Kallberg 2-4 (8-11, 11-8, 9-11, 11-8, 8-11, 9-11).

data.title: Bionic pop artist Viktoria Modesta to speak at GoTech World 2026 in Bucharest
data.description: Viktoria Modesta, known as the “world’s first bionic pop artist,” will deliver a keynote on the second day of GoTech World 2026. The technology conference will take place on November 10-11 at Romexpo’s B1 Pavilion in Bucharest. The artist had her lower leg amputated at age 20 and subsequently began using prosthetics as artistic and technological objects rather than solely as medical devices. At the event in Romania, her keynote will focus on human-centered design and the ways technology can augment rather than replace human potential, the organizers said. It will also examine assistive technology as a means of exploring and redefining the human body. Viktoria Modesta portrayed the Snow Queen during the closing ceremony of the 2012 Paralympic Games, performing alongside Coldplay while wearing a prosthetic covered in Swarovski crystals. Her other projects include a Rolls-Royce art film featuring a prosthetic that generated visible electric arcs and the Zero Gravity project, for which she tested prosthetics designed for microgravity flights. The 15th edition of GoTech World will include 12 thematic stages covering artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, business transformation, digital marketing, and software development, alongside an exhibition area featuring more than 100 companies. Further details can be found here .

data.title: A Taste of Mexico in Bucharest: Día de los Muertos at Aristocool, Radisson Blu Hotel, Bucharest
data.description: For the third consecutive year, Aristocool at Radisson Blu Hotel, Bucharest is celebrating Día de los Muertos, bringing a colorful touch of Mexican culture to the heart of the city. On Friday, October 30, guests are invited to enjoy an evening of live mariachi music, festive flavors and a vibrant atmosphere inspired by one of Mexico's most fascinating traditions. A celebration of life, color and tradition Unlike the spooky traditions typically associated with Halloween, Día de los Muertos, or the Day of the Dead, is a Mexican celebration that honors the memory of loved ones through music, flowers, food and colorful rituals. Recognized by UNESCO as part of humanity's Intangible Cultural Heritage, the tradition embraces remembrance with joy, warmth and a distinctive visual identity. Drawing inspiration from this rich cultural heritage, Aristocool will transform its familiar setting into a festive space filled with vibrant colors and floral decorations. Mariachi music, festive flavors and a lively atmosphere The evening will feature a live performance by Mariachi Los Platanos , bringing the sounds and rhythms of Mexico to central Bucharest. A live DJ will keep the party atmosphere going, while a specially created Halloween menu will add a playful culinary touch to the celebration. From colorful decorations to festive music and themed food and drinks, the event offers an alternative way to enjoy Halloween weekend, with a Mexican-inspired twist. Located on Calea Victoriei, within Radisson Blu Hotel, Bucharest, Aristocool is an all-day social destination known for its relaxed atmosphere, cocktails, dining and entertainment. Now in its third year, the Día de los Muertos party has become part of Aristocool's annual calendar, inviting both hotel guests and Bucharest residents to gather for an evening of music, food and celebration. Entrance is free; themed costumes and advance reservations are encouraged. For reservations and further information: +40 31 630 8556 | Book a table at Aristocool

data.title: Romania’s quantum computing hub in Iași adds Classiq software to IBM hardware
data.description: Classiq, a leading company in quantum computing software, and Romania’s FreeYa Mind Campus announced the signing of a strategic commercial agreement to develop quantum application creation, education, and adoption capabilities for companies and public institutions at the campus's Quantum AI center in Iași. Under the agreement cited by Economedia , FreeYa Mind Campus will provide access to Classiq's enterprise-grade quantum software platform, both on campus and throughout the Romanian ecosystem. The platform brings together Classiq's agentic AI interfaces, the high-level Qmod modeling language, circuit synthesis, and hardware-aware execution, helping researchers and corporate teams design optimized quantum applications faster. “Our partnership with Classiq will connect the quantum hardware available on campus and through the cloud with a leading application development and education environment that can serve universities, companies, and public institutions. This will help Romania develop sustainable quantum skills and contribute to Europe's broader technological objectives,” said Cristian Berariu, founder and CEO of FreeYa Mind Campus. The center was developed to provide on-site access to quantum hardware, including an IBM Quantum System Two . With this deal, the center is set to add Classiq's software, expertise, and training programs to further develop and expand quantum innovation and industrial applications. The initiative will build on the FreeYa Mind Campus network, which comprises companies, research institutions, public sector organizations, and academic partners, including more than 12 partner universities. The center will be open to government organizations and participants in programs funded by the European Union. Classiq will also contribute to expanding the center's training programs, from introductory quantum computing courses to high-level modeling and advanced algorithm design. Furthermore, in collaboration with the campus team, Classiq will connect quantum innovation to practical industrial applications. The campus will provide university curricula, specialist training, introductory programs for companies, advanced application development, and resources for Classiq certification. To support customer relations, project delivery, and application deployment, Classiq will establish its regional headquarters in Romania at FreeYa Mind Campus. “Europe's quantum ambitions depend on combining high-performance software with advanced hardware. Building on the success of FreeYa Mind Campus, we are bringing these components together, with Classiq providing the scalable software foundation that will enable universities, companies, and public institutions to develop quantum applications. This partnership accelerates ecosystem development and creates a clear path from business and research challenges to executable quantum solutions,” said Regev Yativ, CRO of Classiq. The agreement with the Iasi campus is part of Classiq's expanding work with organizations developing large-scale quantum hardware and software centers, application hubs, and local technology infrastructure. It follows Classiq's partnership with TEA TEK to create a quantum computing hub in Naples and its collaboration with QAI to launch a local Quantum-as-a-Service offering in South Korea, a first of its kind. The initiative enables the campus to support its own hardware strategy while introducing a model for developing quantum skills. The hardware provides the computing infrastructure, while Classiq's software component enables researchers, experts from various fields, and developers to learn, create, optimize, and execute applications. Named a “Next Big Thing in Tech” by Fast Company, Classiq is backed by leading global investors and works with quantum cloud service providers, hyperscalers, and quantum hardware companies.

data.title: Update: Romania’s Central Depository targeted in cyberattack
data.description: The Central Depository, the entity through which all transactions on the Bucharest Stock Exchange (BVB) are carried out and which manages all data on transactions and contracts, was the target of a cyberattack on Friday, October 16. The attack impacted the Online Services for Investors application, according to the official press release. This application, which is auxiliary to the Central Depository system, is used to create user accounts for investors (Romanian individuals) interested in accessing the online services provided by the Central Depository. The incident was identified on the day it occurred, and the necessary investigation and remediation measures were taken immediately. System monitoring has been intensified, and operations are proceeding under normal conditions, according to the same source. “The incident did not affect the Central Depository’s critical services and functions related to settlement and registry operations, which are being carried out under normal conditions. In particular, financial instrument holdings and information regarding settled transactions were not accessed, modified, and/or altered,” the Central Depository added. At this time, no user data has been affected, and no information has been lost, because the IT system benefits from a highly efficient backup system, according to Economica . “At this time, the Application is temporarily unavailable. Based on the information available to us so far, personal data belonging to our users were viewed as a result of the cyberattack, namely data used in the user registration/account creation process: first and last name, address, personal numerical identification code, identity card series and number, email address, telephone number, and IBAN code. These data have not been modified and/or altered,” the Central Depository stated. The institution also said that it has already hired a team of specialists and notified the National Directorate for Cyber Security (DNSC) about the cyberattack. The Central Depository's message also includes the steps investors and other people using the application should follow. “Although your password for accessing the Application was not accessed during the cyberattack, if you use the same passwords for multiple online services, we recommend changing them and using separate passwords. Also, enable two-factor authentication, if available. We apologize for the concern and any inconvenience caused by this incident.”

data.title: Kharkiv Missile Strikes Injure 15, Including 3 Children
data.description: Russian missile strikes hit Kharkiv’s Nemyshlianskyi district on Friday evening, Oct. 16, injuring 15 civilians, including three children. The attack damaged residential high-rises, set a commercial warehouse ablaze, and triggered four localized fires that were contained by emergency crews, forming part of an overnight Russian barrage involving ballistic missiles and over 330 strike drones.

Zelensky also called for stronger support for Ukraine, including defense funding, air defense, sanctions and progress toward EU membership.

data.title: Trump Halts Sweeping Russia Sanctions, Citing US National Interest
data.description: President Donald Trump signed an executive order Friday, Oct. 16, waiving sweeping Russia sanctions and tariffs set to take effect Sunday under legislation he signed just a month earlier. The move follows Trump’s diesel deal with Putin, drawing criticism that sanctions relief could fund Russia’s war.

data.title: Zelensky: Starlink Still Not Fully Restored, Disrupting Drone Defense and Frontline Supplies
data.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed Friday, Oct. 16, that the operating capabilities of Ukraine’s military Starlink satellite network have not been fully restored, despite indications that the White House may have intervened with SpaceX. He said restrictions prevented Ukrainian forces from intercepting Russian jet-powered Shahed drones, disrupted strikes against Russian military targets in occupied territory, and interfered with food and water deliveries to frontline troops.

data.title: Pope Leo XIV Speaks to Russian President Vladimir Putin, Urges Ceasefire in Occupied Oleshky

The Kremlin blamed Ukraine for the crisis but backed the Vatican’s initiative. data.title: DSP o Maquiavélico Ganancioso
data.description: Guineenses, mais uma vez, venho para vos alertar sobre o perigo que Domingos Simões Pereira representa para a Guiné-Bissau. Faço esse alerta a todos os guineenses sem exceção que se encontre no país ou no estrangeiro, ao PAIGC em especial e na pessoa do Cipriano Cassamá em concreto. Alerta esse sobre o verdadeiro DSP, o verdadeiro espírito que move esse sujeito, o qual alguns ainda continuam a acreditar para não dizer adorar. data.title: APANHA-SE MAIS DEPRESSA UM MENTIROSO QUE UM COXO!
data.description:
DSP através da sua equipa de "Lambe-Botas" está cavando cada vez mais a sua própria cova, adiantando cada vez mais o seu fim. Somente alguns acreditavam que foi ele quem estava por trás do "Progresso Nacional" o blog onde começou toda essa história de Mentiras, Calunias, Difamações, Ameaças e tantos outros agressões tóxicas ao espírito humano, a todos os que não estão do seu lado e cujo o único objectivo, era ser chamado de rei dos réis da Guiné. Comandou o Progresso Nacional assim como Bin Laden comandou a Al-Qaeda e acabou por fracassar. Pensou, repensou e resolveu voltar novamente ainda com mais TERROR e está a comandar o Guiné Puro tentando levar toda a nação ao abismo assim como o ISIS quer levar a humanidade. Camaradas, Guiné Puro assim como o falecido Progresso Nacional é o reflexo do espirito de DSP, alí é possivel ver tudo e quanto o sujeito é baixo. DSP é um hipócrita e um anarquista moderno. "ACHAS QUE AS NOSSAS MARCHAS SÃO RESULTADO DE VENDAS E COMPRAS?!" essa foi uma das frases da recente publicação que mostram por quem e para que fim, é dirigido o Guiné Puro ou melhor o blog do terror como podem ver já a seguir. Demonstraram mais uma vez claramente que o "MCCI" pertence a DPS, pois uma publicação dessa no próprio blog do ganancioso só pode ser das duas uma: "Boca capli elis ou Foronta passanta e dicidi ca sucundi rostu". Camaradas, Domingos Simões Pereira afundou seu próprio barco devido a sua ganância e complexo de superioridade. "I pirigu pa i faladu ba cuma, el i unicu alguim cu bai escola na Guiné" seu ultimo desejo é "afundar com todos, inclusive o PAIGC". __________PARA A VOSSA CONFIRMAÇÃO, AQUI ESTÁ A PUBLICAÇÃO_________ MARCOS GALINA BARBOSA VAI PERCEBER QUE METEU COM GENTE
PERSISTENTE. BÔ DISSAL I NA BIN FASSI PASSSAÇÃO LI. tUDO PUBLICAÇÕES KU I FASSI
I NA RESP+UNDI PAREL. NIN IKANA SEDU DIDIA. NONA VINGAL MANERA KU NÓ PUDI. JÁ
TEMOS ALGUÉM NO AEROPORTO PARA NOS INFOMAR O DIA EM QUE EL CHEGAR. INVENTOU
AGRESSÃO E NESTE MOMENTO ESTÁ EM QUELUZ EM PORTUGAL. FILHO DA PUTA. MENTIROSO
COMO OS TEUS PATRÕES OS SUJOS JOMAV E BRAIMA CAMARÁ. MARCOS GALINA, BU NA
ARREPENDI. PERA BU DJUBI. ACHAS QUE AS NOSSAS MARCHAS SÃO RESULTADO DE VENDAS E
COMPRAS?! VAMOS PROVAR DEPOIS. FIDJU DI BALETA Olá a todos, ainda bem que descobriram
que o Pirata informático- hackec é o Marcos Galina Barbosa, Eng. Informático.
Tentei várias vezes avisar o Ticha Aly Silva mas ele não respondeu e nem deu
importância julgo eu. No tempo da campanha para a liderança do Paigc, este
indivíduo era um fervoroso apoiante do Bá Quecuto no Facebook e a técnica que
usava era o envio de Phishing aos apoiantes do Dsp, recolhia informações
pessoais das pessoas que posteriormente eram expostas no Blog do Doka. Tentou
comigo mas não resultou. Tenham cuidado com este sujeito que está nas mãos de
B. Camara. Outra coisa, gostaria de conhecer a vossa página no Fecebook. Estamos Juntos. AC Nota GP: Até jovens inocentes,
Lesmes, Masta Tito e demais outros, os tais vendidos e comprados foram as tuas
vítimas. teu filho da puta que o bandido de Baciro Djá trouxe para Bissau para funções no aparelho de Estado e dizes que outros recebem favores.
Desde quando é que és mais honesto ou
mais competentes que os outros? Pagas e até pode ser com a tua vida para
perceberes as irresponsabilidades
dos teus actos. Publicada por O

data.title: DSP, UM PERIGO GRAVE PARA FUTURO DO PAÍS
data.description: Os meios de comunicação também são as formas de manipulação mais utilizadas pelos poderes políticos, dado o seu impacto social. As informações são manipuladas não apenas tendo em vista omitir factos relevantes, mas também distorcer o conteúdo da informação veiculada, produzir ou forjar a opinião pública, de modo que a mesma se ajuste às ideias dos gananciosos. A única forma dos cidadãos evitarem cair nestes processos de manipulação é tornarem-se mais vigilantes em relação às instituições democráticas e aos órgãos de informação, adoptando uma atitude de permanente reflexão crítica sobre a informação que lhes é fornecida. Na Guiné-Bissau, nos últimos anos, cresceu exponencialmente o número de pessoas mediocres, pessoas sem escrúpulos ligadas à produção de rádios e outros meios de comunicação com influencia na nossa sociedade, gente que apesar da sua enorme influência na sociedade, trabalha na mais completa impunidade e sem qualquer controlo ético/democrático. Obcecado pelo poder, ciente da dificuldade do povo guineense em avaliar informações, ciente do poder dos instrumentos de comunicação, Domingos Simões Pereira (DSP) nunca menosprezou esses instrumentos para atingir seu objectivo, sempre usou-os de forma desonesta como agora está a fazer tudo por tudo para manter no controlo desses veicúlos, mesmo que isso custe a vida dos outros. Governou na corrupção, no nepotismo e no desvios de somas astronómicas do dinheiro de povo, que muito serviria para investimentos na saúde, educação e outros serviços publicos, para beneficiar familiares e amigos. Finge que preocupa com os problemas do país, mas só engana o povo honesto, humilde e trabalhador que infelizmente sofre muito, não sei até quando, devido a sua paciência e tolerância aos governantes como DSP, criminoso travestido em politico que vive na custa de povo e acima de tudo ainda fa-lo refem do próprio suor. Roubou e decepcionou tanto não só aos guineenses assim como a comunidade internacional que sempre acreditou que o sujeito era ideal para ajudar esse povo a sair do ciclo de sofrimento que parece infinito. Foi demitido, não conformou e está a fazer tudo na medida do possível para continuar a complicar a vida dos guineenses. Razão disso é que depois de perder a batalha nos meios de comunicações mais modernos nomeadamente os blogues onde investiu grandes somas do dinheiro de povo, para fazer a lavagem cerebral dos menos instruídos e não só. Fugiu do facebook onde sempre frequentava e comunicava com todos tentado passar a mensagem de um politico moderno e aberto a diálogo/opiniões, mas que afinal era simplesmente um falso modernista. Caiu a mascara e já não consegue enganar ninguem, pois a sua credibilidade está abaixo de zero, para não dizer outra coisa. Camaradas, para conhecimento geral, com o dinheiro roubado que custou suor de povo guineense, DSP decidiu avançar com um outro novo plano maquiavelico, para criar a sua própria estação de rádio. Documento António Aly Silva » aaly.silva@gmail.com » aaly_silva@hotmail.com » Tel. (+245) 668 31 13

data.title: DSP não respeita os antigos combatentes e sempre usou e abusou desses camaradas. Prova disso é que continuou a governar mesmo já com Carlos Correia como primeiro ministro. Usou até o cadáver de Carmem Perreira para promover sua imagem, pois é sabido que a malograda como sendo antigo combatente e membro do PAIGC o corpo só deveria passar por ANP e sede do partido e nunca na Primatura como aconteceu, e por cima de tudo com indivíduos alí barricados por vontade própria vandalizando instituição do estado o que demonstra uma clara promoção ao anarquismo. Não respeitou nem o Pai da Nação(ALC), nem o PR quanto mais o formalismo de um estado de direito democrático, prova disso mais uma vez, o ganancioso após o PR ter depositado coroas de flores no túmulo de ALC no dia dos heróis nacionais, reuniu os seus "gangs" para o mesmo efeito, conseguiu até mobilizar um dos familiares do Pai da Nação para lhe acompanhar tudo isso para manipular e dividir os guineenses "guineenses ku udjus fitchadu" para os seus intereses obscuros.
